question: Identify the top 3 German drivers born between 1980 and 1985 who recorded the fastest lap times in races held at Austrian circuits. Return their full names and the race name.

FROM lapTimes AS lt
JOIN drivers AS d ON d."XCL_034" = lt."XCL_044"
JOIN races AS r ON r."XCL_065" = lt."XCL_043"
JOIN circuits AS c ON c."XCL_001" = r."XCL_068"
WHERE d."XCL_041" = 'German'
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', d."XCL_040") AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1985
  AND c."XCL_005" = 'Austria'
ORDER BY lt."XCL_048" ASC
LIMIT 3
